Notification of Relevant Shareholding 
 
Dear Investor Relations Team, 
 
In accordance with the applicable Brazilian securities regulations, we hereby notify you that the shareholding interest 
held by entities managed by M&G Plc in MRV ENGENHARIA E PARTICIPACOES SA has fallen below the relevant 
reporting threshold. 
 
ISIN: BRMRVEACNOR2 
Number of Shares Held: 27,591,122 
Percentage of Share Capital: 4.90% 
Date Threshold Crossed: 13/10/2026 
 
Please treat this correspondence as our formal notification of the relevant shareholding position. 
 
Should you require any additional information, please do not hesitate to contact us. 
 
Kind regards, 
 
George Rose 
for and on behalf of M&G Investment Management Limited 
Direct Line +44 20 8162 3276 
Email shareholder.disclosures@mandg.co.uk
